title: UK Spouse & Partner Visas | Unique Visa Services
description: Help with UK spouse, civil partner, fiancé and unmarried partner visas, including extensions. IAA-regulated advisers in Manchester.
intro: If your husband, wife, civil partner, fiancé or long-term partner is British or settled in the UK, a partner visa lets you live here together. We help you choose the right route, meet the financial requirement and put together strong relationship evidence.

faqs.q: Can civil partners apply on the same route?
faqs.a: Yes. Civil partners apply on the same partner route as married couples, with the same requirements.

faqs.q: What is the most common reason partner visas are refused?
faqs.a: Missing or incorrect financial evidence. The Home Office is strict about which documents count and which dates they must cover, so we check this carefully before you apply.
